seoTitle: Web App Manifest Generator for PWAs
metaDescription: Build manifest.webmanifest with name, icons, display mode, theme colours and installability checks, plus the HTML link tags.
intro: Create the web app manifest that lets browsers install your site as an app, with checks for the most common installability mistakes.
why:
Fill in the name, short name, start URL, scope, display mode, orientation, colours, language and icons (path:WxH, add :maskable for maskable icons). The tool outputs valid JSON with icon MIME types inferred from the file extension, the link and meta tags to add to your HTML and a short checklist: 192 and 512 pixel icons, a maskable icon, a short name of 12 characters or less, and a start URL inside the scope.

Installability also needs HTTPS and, in some browsers, a service worker with a fetch handler; serve the manifest as application/manifest+json.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter your app name, start URL and colours.
Copy the JSON to manifest.webmanifest and the tags into your <head>.
Test with the Application panel in browser dev tools.

faq.a: An icon with extra safe-zone padding so Android can crop it to different shapes without cutting off the artwork.

faq.q: Do I need a service worker?
faq.a: Chromium requires installability criteria including HTTPS; offline support needs a service worker, which the service worker generator can write.
It limits which URLs belong to the app; navigating outside it opens a normal browser tab.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
